public_rationale: The evidence shows concern about dependence on US models and continued sovereign AI initiatives. It does not establish a broad international adoption shift toward sovereign and Chinese alternatives caused by this decision. Some cooperation predates the decision. With no deadline and no decisive adoption evidence, the forecast remains open.
limitations: Private procurement decisions may not be public.
Reading rushing towards as political interest alone would make the evidence more favorable.
The available source taxonomy lacks a category for government policy statements; company_disclosure labels here identify institutional primary disclosures, not corporate financial evidence.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: The rushed and seemingly unprincipled White House decision will leave the rest of the world rushing towards 'sovereign AI' (for example from European or Canadian companies) and even Chinese AI, rather than deal with US uncertainty in which any model can be shut down at any time without warning or clear explanation.

statement.excerpt: Thue rushed and seemingly unprincipled decision will leave the rest of the world rushing towards “sovereign AI” (made for example by European or Canadian companies) and even Chinese AI, rather than deal with the uncertainty in the US

from_speaker: will leave the rest of the world rushing towards

our_interpretation: The plain reading is a broad international shift in AI procurement or adoption caused by the June White House decision and the shutdown uncertainty it created.
The claim requires movement toward sovereign and Chinese alternatives. Expressions of concern, investment proposals and isolated purchases do not establish the whole prediction.
The rest of the world describes the forecast's scope, not a conditional antecedent.
No deadline or numerical threshold is supplied.
criteria.support_condition: Dated procurement or adoption evidence shows a broad international shift toward sovereign and Chinese AI after the decision, with credible buyer statements or analysis linking that shift to US shutdown uncertainty.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence covering the claimed international shift establishes that it did not occur or that its attributed cause was wrong. A short period without a shift cannot contradict this forecast without a deadline.
